subject: Print MCMC iteration number while running

messages.author: 42eec6aa1e70a8d1
messages.subject: Print MCMC iteration number while running
parts:
Hi,

I started learning Nimble very recently. Is there a way to print the MCMC progress (iteration number or, say, every 1000th iteration number) while its running ?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Print MCMC iteration number while running

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Print MCMC iteration number while running
parts:
Following Daniel’s response: Are you using a version that shows the progress bar, and if so is that adequate to your need?

We’ve had some delays updating versions due to CRAN issues.  If you install from CRAN or from our development branch (“devel”) in GitHub, you’ll get the progress bars.  To do the latter, you can use

library(devtools)
install_github("nimble-dev/nimble", ref = "devel", subdir = "packages/nimble")

If you want something more than the progress bar, you could go into the package source code, into file MCMC_build.R, copy the buildMCMC nimbleFunction into your own code file with changes in the run function to output what you want, and use that version instead of buildMCMC.  You might need to remove the “where = getLoadingNamespace()” as that is particular to nimbleFunctions when defined in package source code. Let me know if that doesn’t make sense.

Perry

Btw Nimble is awesome. Kudos for making a great software. I plan on using it a lot in the future. 

Best,
Abhi
